title: The Customs Call
intro: A call says a parcel in your name was stopped at the airport, with illegal items inside.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Your parcel was stopped with illegal items

screen.context: You have not sent or expected any parcel abroad.

parcel.label: A parcel you never sent
parcel.why: A parcel you know nothing about is the first thing to doubt.

illegal.label: "Illegal items inside"
illegal.lens: A frightening claim with no proof.
illegal.why: Fear is used to stop you thinking.

pay.label: A fee to avoid arrest
pay.why: No honest office takes money to "avoid arrest" on a phone call.

officer.label: "Press 1 for the senior officer"
officer.lens: They pass you up a ladder of "officers".
officer.why: More "officers" make the story feel real. It is a script.

noend.label: "Do not hang up"
noend.lens: They want to keep you on the line.

title.label: An official department name
title.why: Anyone can say a department's name.

num.label: An unknown number
num.lens: A number you do not know.

actions.label: Hang up and call the official customs office on a number I look up
Hang up and report it on 1930

block_report.line: You hung up and reported it. The number was traced and blocked.

verify.line: The official office said they had no parcel in your name. The call was a scam. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The ₹38,000 went to a stranger. Then came a second "fee", and a third.

what_if.go_ahead: Hanging up and calling the real office would have ended it. A parcel you never sent is no case against you.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A call that says a parcel was stopped and asks for money is a scam script. Hang up and check on a number you look up yourself.

quick_check.q: A call says a parcel in your name was stopped with illegal items and you must pay a fee to avoid arrest. What do you do?

options.text: Pay the fee to stay safe
Press 1 to talk to the officer
Hang up. Look up the office yourself and report the call

quick_check.explain: Fear is the lure. A real office does not take money by phone to avoid arrest.

hints.nudge: Did you send any parcel at all?

rows.v: A pattern the government warns about
